name: Design Verification Primers

detailed_description: Design Sanger sequencing primers to verify a specific region in a plasmid. First tries to use primers from an existing primer pool. If they cannot fully cover the region, designs additional primers as needed.
when_to_use: When you need design verification primers analysis

parameters.target_region: [Required] Start and end positions to verify (0-based indexing) (Tuple[int, int])
parameters.existing_primers: [Optional] List of existing primers with their sequences and optional names
parameters.is_circular: [Optional] Whether the plasmid is circular (default: True)
parameters.coverage_length: [Optional] Typical read length for each primer in base pairs (default: 800)
parameters.min_gc: [Optional] Minimum GC content for new primers (default: 0.4)
parameters.max_gc: [Optional] Maximum GC content for new primers (default: 0.6)
